text: APPROVE: The extraction preserves the original order (list subdirs, skip on error, push walkable ones, list files, skip on error), keeps enumeration materialised inside the try so exceptions are still caught, and removes the nested foreach/if/&&/catch branches that drove the complexity, so it should now be under 15 and still compile, assuming nullable and implicit usings (System.Linq) are enabled, which I did not verify.
